test_faiss_embedding_layer: test that faiss.Embedding produces the same output as PyTorch nn.Embedding for a batch of indices
test_faiss_linear_layer: test that faiss.Linear produces the same output as PyTorch nn.Linear with and without bias
test_QINCoStep_decode: test the QINCoStep decode method by comparing PyTorch and Faiss implementations for codebook lookup and residual blocks
test_QINCoStep_encode: test the QINCoStep encode method by comparing PyTorch and Faiss implementations for encoding vectors to codes
test_IndexQINCo_search: test IndexQINCo search by training a ResidualQuantizer, converting codebooks to QINCo, and verifying search results match
